text: 测试工程师 大肥鱼（DSH 插件，适用于 DSH 客户端）：在对话中组织 HTTP 接口和网页的黑盒功能测试。插件向 DSH 注册 HTTP 执行、浏览器 UI 执行和报告生成工具，并提供功能测试方法论 skill。HTTP 测试可按套件或内联用例发送请求、检查状态码与字段并保存证据；网页测试通过本机 Chrome 或 Edge 执行步骤、断言和截图；报告工具可汇总已有运行记录。适合进行接口验收、页面回归和前后端数据核对。使用时需提供待测目标地址；鉴权凭据可从环境变量读取。

Test Engineer Big Fat Fish is a DSH plugin for black-box API and browser UI tests. Its tools run HTTP cases, exercise Chrome or Edge flows, and create reports from saved runs. Use it for API acceptance and page regression. Supply a target address; credentials may come from environment variables.
我想让 DSH 按用例调用测试环境接口并检查响应字段。
能不能用浏览器自动操作网页并验证页面结果？
我需要把多轮接口或页面测试结果整理成一份报告。
功能「HTTP 接口用例执行」：通过 ft_http_run 接收套件或内联用例，向目标地址发请求并按声明的断言检查响应，随后保存运行记录与证据。
功能「网页流程测试与报告」：ft_ui_run 使用本机 Chrome 或 Edge 执行页面步骤并收集断言结果；ft_report 可从保存的运行记录生成单次或汇总报告。
测试执行会向用户传入的 HTTP 或网页目标地址发送请求；使用认证配置时，凭据从指定环境变量读取。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 测试工程师 大肥鱼 · Test Engineer Big Fat Fish：**面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒功能测试插件**：接口、页面、前后端一致性，用对话驱动。

section: 测试工程师 大肥鱼 · Test Engineer Big Fat Fish

text:
dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 它是什么：`dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish` 是一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Host 组合包：注册 3 个执行工具 + 1 个方法论 skill。

| 类型 | 名称 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工具 | `ft_http_run` | 批量发 HTTP 请求（套件或内联用例），断言 `status` / `jsonPath` / `headers` / `latencyMs`，提取变量，落盘证据 |
| 工具 | `ft_ui_run` | 用 `playwright-core` 驱动本机 Chrome/Edge：页面流程、选择器、等待、断言、截图、收集控制台报错与失败请求 |
| 工具 | `ft_report` | 从已落盘的 run 重新生成人读报告（单个或汇总，支持标记已知失败） |
| Skill | `functional-testing` | 方法论：需求 → 接口/UI 入口摸底 → 用例设计 → 数据确认 → 执行 → 归因 → 每轮档案与报告 |

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 它是什么：Skill 负责「测什么、期望是什么、失败算谁的」——是产品缺陷、用例缺陷还是环境问题；工具只负责执行和留证据，**不猜**。

它擅长：

- 通过**真实接口、真实页面**做版本/模块验收与回归（不 mock、不改项目源码）；
- 每项目复用**登录档案**：登录接口探明一次后，之后每轮默认「登录 + 本轮功能」联合测试；
- 每轮留下**可复现**的档案：目标 / 覆盖范围 / 测试数据 / 异常复现方式；
- 前后端一致性：同一份数据经接口与页面分别读取，逐字段比对。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 安装：> 需要带插件管理器的 DSH（Host bundle 支持）与 Node 22+；UI 测试还需要本机装有 Chrome 或 Edge。

从 GitHub 安装（建议固定 tag 或 commit）：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Utaoki-henji/dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish#v0.1.1
```

**桌面端**：打开 **设置 → 插件 → 安装**，填上面的 spec（或 `https://github.com/Utaoki-henji/dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish`），然后重启 Harness。

**离线 / 对话安装**：拿到发布包 `dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish-v<version>.zip`，让助手安装即可——发布包自带 `node_modules/playwright-core`，安装时不需要联网。

安装后插件显示为 **测试工程师 大肥鱼**，并带 `functional-testing` skill。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 用法：在对话里说「开始测试」/「开始测试接口」/「开始测试页面」，或英文 "start testing"。

skill 会按顺序确认：项目 → 测试类型（接口 / 页面 / 模块）→ 入口地址或路由 → 登录档案（需要令牌时**不猜路径**）→ 只读代码得出契约与分支清单 → 多接口执行逻辑（顺序/分支/并行 + 具体顺序）→ 测试数据确认卡 → 先冒烟再全量 → 每轮档案与报告。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 工作区状态：所有状态都在当前工作区的 `.ft/` 下（不写你的项目源码）：

```text
.ft/
  config.json              # 接口/UI 基址、允许的主机、写操作放行、响应体上限
  credentials.local.json   # 本地凭据库（被 gitignore，环境变量优先）
  logins/<project>.json    # 登录档案：接口、令牌路径、鉴权头、凭据环境变量名

`ensureWorkspaceState` 会写入 `.ft/.gitignore`，避免 run、凭据、鉴权产物进入你的仓库。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 环境要求：- 带插件管理器的 DSH（Host bundle 支持）；
- Node.js 22+（ESM）；
- `ft_ui_run` 需要本机 Chrome 或 Edge（直接驱动已装浏览器，不下载浏览器内核）；
- 能访问你要测的目标地址。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 安全与隐私：- **对项目只读**：不改源码、不插桩、不跑你的构建；
- **只写**工作区 `.ft/`；
- **凭据**来自环境变量或 `.ft/credentials.local.json`，日志/证据/套件按敏感键脱敏，落盘保留 `${env:...}` 占位符；
- **无遥测**：只访问你给的目标地址；
- **写操作需显式授权**：非 GET 用例必须标 `destructive: true` 且被 `.ft/config.json` 放行；
- UI 自动化使用独立浏览器上下文，不碰你日常浏览器的 profile。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 边界：- **执行层只有黑盒**：HTTP 请求 + 真实浏览器 UI；没有单测执行、没有覆盖率、没有断点插桩；
- **白盒只读静态**：第 5 步允许只读 Java/Spring Controller、DTO、`@Valid`、Service 分支、Vue 路由与 API 层来推导期望，不执行任何代码；
- `concurrency` 固定为 1，并行请求按确认顺序串行；
- `ft_ui_run` 使用本机 Chrome/Edge，支持无头模式与登录态注入（`storageState` / cookies）。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · 许可证：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · English：**Black-box functional testing for DeepSeek Harness** — HTTP APIs, Vue/Web pages, and front-end/back-end consistency, driven by conversation.
dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · What it is：`dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish` is a DSH Host bundle. It adds three executor tools and one methodology skill:

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · What it is：| Kind | Name | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tool | `ft_http_run` | Sends HTTP requests (suite of cases or inline cases), evaluates `status` / `jsonPath` / `headers` / `latencyMs` assertions, extracts variables, persists evidence |
| Tool | `ft_ui_run` | Drives local Chrome/Edge via `playwright-core`: page flows, selectors, waits, assertions, screenshots, console and failed-request capture |
| Tool | `ft_report` | Rebuilds a human-readable report from stored runs (single or aggregated, with known-failure marking) |
| Skill | `functional-testing` | The methodology: requirements → interface/UI entry review → test-case design → data confirmation → execution → attribution → per-round record and report |

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · What it is：The skill owns **what to test, what "expected" means, and whether a failure is a product bug, a test-case bug, or an environment problem**. The tools only execute and keep evidence — they never guess.

What it is good at:

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · What it is：- Acceptance/regression testing of a version or module through its **real interfaces and real pages** (no mocks, no source changes).
- Reusing a **login profile** per project: after a login interface is probed once, every later round runs `login + feature` together.
- Writing per-round records: goal, coverage, test data, anomaly reproduction — so a report can be reproduced by another person.
- Front-end/back-end consistency checks: the same data read through the API and rendered on the page, compared field by field.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Installation：> Requires a DSH build with the plugin manager and Node 22+. UI tests additionally need local Chrome or Edge.

Install from GitHub (pin a tag or commit for reproducibility):

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Utaoki-henji/dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish#v0.1.1
```

**Desktop app**: open **Settings → Plugins → Install**, and enter the spec above (or `https://github.com/Utaoki-henji/dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish`). Then restart the Harness.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Installation：**Offline / conversation install**: download the release bundle (`dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish-v<version>.zip`) and ask the assistant to install it — the bundle ships its own `node_modules/playwright-core` and needs no network during install.

After installing, the plugin appears as **测试工程师 大肥鱼** with the `functional-testing` skill.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Usage：Start a conversation turn with one of:

- 「开始测试」 / 「开始测试接口」 / 「开始测试页面」
- "start testing", "test this API", "test this page"

The skill then walks these steps, asking you for what it cannot know:

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Usage：1. **Confirm the project** (name / repository / service).
2. **Choose the test kind**: interface only · UI only · module (API + UI + front-end/back-end consistency).
3. **Give the entry**: API base URL and path (or Controller/API doc) or the UI route; environment and credential source.
4. **Login profile**: if the interface needs a token, it reads `.ft/logins/<project>.json`; without a profile it asks you for the login interface rather than guessing a path.
5. **Read the code** (read-only) to derive the contract and branch checklist — never modified, never instrumented.
6. **Confirm execution logic** for multiple interfaces: sequential / branching / parallel, and the concrete order (it will not infer call chains from code structure).
7. **Prepare test data** and show you a data-confirmation card before writing anything.
8. **Execute**: 3–5 smoke cases first, then the full set; one run per topic.
9. **Record and report**: per-round goal, coverage, test data, anomaly reproduction, plus a combined report.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Workspace state：Everything the plugin keeps lives under `.ft/` in the current workspace (never in your project source):

```text
.ft/
  config.json              # api/ui base URLs, allowed hosts, destructive rules, size limits
  credentials.local.json   # local credential store (gitignored; env vars override it)
  logins/<project>.json    # login profile: endpoint, token path, auth header, env var names
dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Workspace state：`ensureWorkspaceState` writes a `.ft/.gitignore` so runs, credentials and auth artifacts never leak into your repository.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Requirements：- DSH with plugin manager (Host bundle support).
- Node.js 22+ (ESM).
- Local Chrome or Edge for `ft_ui_run` (it drives your installed browser; no browser download required).
- Network access to the targets you test.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Safety and privacy：- **Read-only on your project**: the plugin never edits project source, never injects instrumentation, never runs your build.
- **Writes are confined** to the workspace `.ft/` state directory.
- **Secrets**: credentials come from environment variables or `.ft/credentials.local.json`. Logs, evidence and persisted suites redact secret keys (`authorization`, `cookie`, `password`, `token`, …) and keep `${env:...}` placeholders instead of values.
- **No telemetry**: the tools talk only to the base URLs you provide.
- **Destructive calls are opt-in**: non-GET calls must be marked `destructive: true` in the case and allowed by `.ft/config.json`.
- UI automation launches an isolated browser context; it does not touch your everyday browser profile.

dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · Scope and limitations：- **Execution is black-box only**: HTTP requests plus real-browser UI flows. There is no unit-test execution, no code coverage, no breakpoints or instrumentation.
- **White-box is static and read-only**: during step 5 the assistant may read Java/Spring controllers, DTOs, validation and service branches, or Vue routes and API layers, to derive expectations. Nothing is executed from that reading.
- `concurrency` is fixed at 1; parallel requests run sequentially in the confirmed order.
- `ft_ui_run` uses the local Chrome/Edge channel. Headless mode and login state (`storageState` / cookies) are supported.
dsh-plugin-big-fat-fish README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
